<%=foreach appUsers%> <%=end%>
AppUsers
# First Name Last Name Login Id Admin Edit Processed Super Admin Inactive Date
<%=#counter appUsers, '4R,'%> <%=firstName, '50L.'%> <%=lastName, '50L.'%> <%=loginId, '50L.'%> <%=admin, '5L.'%> <%=editProcessed, '5L.'%> <%=superAdmin, '11L.'%> <%=inactiveDate, '8L.'%>

PropertyValues
# Name Value Ignore Note

ServerApplications
